subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Narudia ujumbe wangu wa awali kuhusu kuendesha ununuzi wa kwanza kwa {Brand} kama tunavyofanya kwa Kilimall na Copia. Nukta moja inayostahili kurudiwa: tunaboresha kuelekea tukio moja tu, ununuzi wa kwanza uliothibitishwa wenye kitambulisho cha agizo na mapato, unaonusurika dirisha la marejesho, hivyo unalipa kwa maagizo halisi peke yake huku bonyezo na kuongeza kwenye kikapu vikibaki nje ya malipo. Kwa kiwango tunazalisha ununuzi 8,000 kwa siku. Naweza kukutumia mtazamo wa ununuzi kwa kategoria. Je, tunaweza kuangalia kwa kifupi?
illustrative_flags: ununuzi 8,000 kwa siku (8,000 validated purchases per day) - MobUpps, illustrative placeholder calibrated to the ecommerce UA band, not an audited result
register_notes: Stage 1 sw Kenya ecommerce UA: references prior email in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to one validated first purchase with order ID + revenue, surviving return window, pay only for real orders); one illustrative figure (8,000 purchases/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native Swahili, Habari greeting + RECIPIENT_NAME slot; brands Kilimall/Copia from parent only; no sign-off; no em dash; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
